title: Screening-gated access provisioning
objective: Refuse access grants to customer data or production unless a current screening record and signed agreements exist for the person.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)

title: Identity-driven deprovisioning with cross-system reconciliation
objective: Revoke all accounts, sessions, tokens and keys from a single identity source on departure, role change or contract end, and reconcile daily for orphaned access across all systems including AI tools and agents.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)

title: Praxis actor and execution provenance
objective: Attribute each work event and artifact contribution in governed repositories to a stable actor (human, agent, automation) and an execution id.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)
notes: Verified from docs/agent-provenance.md and provenance blocks in this repository. Not operated for a production Echelon service.

title: Agent tool brokering and self-approval prevention
objective: Give each AI agent only the tools and data scopes its role needs through a broker that removes prohibited tools, and prevent agents from approving or merging their own changes or executing reserved actions.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)

title: Training and acknowledgment tracking
objective: Assign onboarding and annual training and policy acknowledgments and block continued access when overdue beyond a grace period.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)

title: Two-person rule for control-relevant changes and privileged actions
objective: Require two approvers, neither the author, for changes to control-relevant modules and for privileged production actions; break-glass actions require post-event review.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)
residual_risks: With fewer than three people this rule may be unsatisfiable; an external reviewer or independent gate must count as an approver.
